title: River Thames centerline through London and gazetteer for an annotated edition of The Waste Land
source: OpenStreetMap relation 2263653 (River Thames, type=waterway), fetched from www.openstreetmap.org/api/0.6/relation/2263653/full (Overpass mirrors were unavailable). Its main_stream member ways were stitched into one line, clipped to the London bbox, Douglas-Peucker simplified (20 m) and resampled to ~250 m spacing. Places geocoded with Nominatim (nominatim.openstreetmap.org), except where the per-place source says otherwise.

projection.note: Simple equirectangular (plate carree) projection for a London map. Convert with x = (lon - lon0) * cos(51.5 deg) and y = lat - lat0, then scale x and y by the SAME pixels-per-degree factor S so that distances are locally true (1 unit = 1 degree of latitude = ~110.6 km). cos(51.5 deg) = 0.6225.

formula.screen: px = x * S; py = (y_extent - y) * S  (y flipped for screen coordinates); S = pixels per degree, identical for both axes

projection.example: For a 1000 px wide canvas: S = 1000 / x_extent = 3735.8 px/deg, giving a canvas height of 523 px.
